column3: MT 7:2; the following verses of this chapter are MT +1. “Daughter of a noble” is rendered “prince’s daughter,” “thighs” as “hips,” and “a master-craftsman” as “an artist.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The bowl of roundness” is rendered “a round goblet,” and the wish “may it not lack” as “Which never lacks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Watches the face of Damascus” is rendered “faces toward Damascus.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your head on you” is rendered “Your head crowns you,” “purple wool” as “purple threads,” and “bound” as “captivated.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O love, with the delights” is rendered “My love, with all your charms.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Clusters” is rendered “its clusters.”
Close to the Hebrew; The present “I say” is rendered “I said,” and “your nose” as “your breath.”
“The lips of sleepers” is rendered “the lips of those who fall asleep,” and NASB breaks the speech after the first line. The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Let us go [to] the field” is rendered “let us go out into the country.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “go,” and the plural “my loves” is rendered “my love.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Choice things” is rendered “choice fruits,” and “stored up” as “saved up.”
